summary: Mark a Node Timeout as event-loop-ref'ed and return the same handle.

target.notes: Set liveness ref state idempotently and return the receiver.

semantics.effect: requests that active timer keep event loop alive

caveats: Ref state affects process liveness, not callback scheduling priority.

tests.name: restores hasRef
tests.input: const t=setTimeout(()=>{},1000); t.unref(); t.ref(); console.log(t.hasRef()); clearTimeout(t);
